scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --wait && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm db:seed
scripts.db:verify: docker compose exec -T postgres bash -c 'r=0; bash /db/verify-roles.sh || r=1; bash /db/verify-schema.sh || r=1; exit $r'
scripts.db:roles: docker compose exec -T postgres bash -c 'psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 --single-transaction -U postgres -d $POSTGRES_DB -v migrator_pw=$MIGRATOR_PASSWORD -v runtime_pw=$APP_RUNTIME_PASSWORD -v purger_pw=$PURGER_PASSWORD -v expect_db=$POSTGRES_DB -f /db/roles.sql'
